rule: Definition of the quotient set by a subgroup

conditions.justification: The ambient group is given explicitly.

conditions.condition: N is a subgroup of G.
conditions.justification: The subgroup assumption is stated explicitly and suffices to form its left cosets.

circularity.justification: The claim only unpacks the notation G/N and does not assume that G/N already has a group structure.

conclusion.statement: The elements of G/N are left cosets aN.
conclusion.justification: By definition, G/N denotes the set {aN : a in G} of left cosets of N in G. Normality is unnecessary for this set-level statement.

reason: The submitted sentence is the defining description of the quotient set G/N, supported by the group and subgroup assumptions.
